newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Citizen emerges as 150 mln rand black bank.
newsitem.headline: Citizen emerges as 150 mln rand black bank.

text.p: South Africa's Citizen Bank Ltd, a unit of listed concern Citizen Bank Holdings Ltd (CBH), said on Monday it had completed a planned restructuring with the acquisition of Bophuthatswana Building Society (BBS) and FutureBank Ltd.

The move is part of a deal which creates a new black-controlled banking group with a capital base of 150 million rand. CBH is jointly controlled by Thebe Investment Corp and First National Bank Holdings Ltd (FNB).
The purchase of BBS for 61.6 million rand as a going concern, effective retrospectively from July 1, 1996, follows an announcement of the planned deal on July 25.
Citizen Bank Holdings is also acquiring FutureBank Ltd's business for 42.1 million rand and has entered into an agreement with FNB in which the bank will become a strategic partner.

"FNB has agreed to become CBH's strategic banking partner holding 25 percent of the equity in CBH and providing primary and secondary support services for a period of ten years," said CBH chairman Vusi Khanyile in a statement.
Of the toal purchase consideration for BBS and FutureBank, 91.7 million rand will be settled by the issue of CBH shares, thereby increasing the capital of the new banking group to 150 million rand.
